audit.whatIsWrong: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeGood string verbatim under an unrelated title. lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeBad string verbatim under an unrelated title.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Ashen Pursuit is a 10s dash and Purgatory reaches 1000 units — a centered wave with lit flanks forces him to enter from the front.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Holding Lucent Singularity to detonate at half HP hands Ashen Pursuit its 10s window — detonate early and step outside his 425 range.

notes: QA re-scope: previous edits to dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
